exposure: type of hospital (private for-profit vs public)
cohort: The study included 61,833 women who sustained an obstetrical anal sphincter injury (OASI) repair following a vaginal delivery in France.
finding: Approximately 2.8% of women experienced OASI complications within two years of primary repair, with instrumental deliveries, stage IV OASIS, obesity, maternal age, and private for-profit hospitals identified as predictive factors for complications.
mod_finding: Instrumental deliveries were significantly associated with an increased risk of OASI complication repairs.
